four_stream_process.source: University of Oklahoma, ChE design course notes 'Minimum Utility', Example 1.1 (https://ou.edu/class/che-design/a-design/Minimum%20Utility.pdf). Classic example also in Kemp (2007), Ch. 2 (not consulted).

brewery_base.source: Padullés et al. (2026), Energy Conversion and Management 357, 121292, Sec. 4.1 and Fig. 4. Published values are rounded in the paper.

Qc_min.comment: Known discrepancy: Table 2 implies Qc_min - Qh_min = -6.6, the paper reports -6.8.

brewery_indirect.source: Padullés et al. (2026), Sec. 4.1: additional 2 K shift for indirect transfer through an intermediate medium.

northwestern_4stream.source: Northwestern University Process Design Open Textbook, 'Pinch analysis' worked example (https://processdesign.mccormick.northwestern.edu/index.php/Pinch_analysis), dTmin = 20 K. Stream 2 load listed as 1800 kW is inconsistent with its CP x dT (2700 kW); CP data used.

milk_evaporator.source: Walmsley et al. (2024), Energies 17, 2838, Table 2 and Fig. 8 (Q_D = 3.54 MW, Q_S = 0.46 MW). Values published to 0.01 MW.
